title: 2010 Rust Rewrite Mashup
tagline: Modern Warfare 2, Skate 3 and an endless Minecraft world in one game.
description: Modern Warfare 2's multiplayer maps, guns, killstreaks and HUD, rebuilt in Rust. Press J on any map to drop onto a board with Skate 3's physics, tricks and grinds. Or pick the Minecraft map: a real, endless Minecraft world with its mobs, day and night, where you shoot blocks to break them, blow craters with grenades and build with an MW2-style inventory. Controllers work with MW2's console layouts and aim assist.

version.note: Any Steam copy with the multiplayer files installed. Your MW2 folder isn't changed.

requirements.notes: An internet connection the first time you play the Minecraft map: it downloads Minecraft's own files (about 125 MB) from Mojang. A controller for skating.

credits.name: vladtrc and IW4L contributors
credits.role: IW4L, the MW2 rewrite it runs on

knownIssues: The skateboard is invisible on some maps.
The first time it starts, it asks you to confirm your MW2 folder and whether you have Skate 3.

important.text: Skating is optional. To skate, have your own Skate 3 for Xbox 360 extracted to a folder with default.xex and a data folder in it (an ISO file won't work). The game asks for that default.xex the first time it starts.
